text_block_list.text:
During lunch break,
as I was helping maintain the farm tools――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Alright!
The veggies are looking nice and fresh today too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, amore!
Are you working hard in the fields today as well?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Earth-san!?
P-Please don't look at me~!
I'm all covered in dirt right now...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Lend me a hand, amore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to these hands, the vegetables in the field
always grow up so *animato*.
It is precisely because they're covered in soil that they're so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Please, don't call yourself dirty. You are always so full of life, kind, and beautiful—and that's the you I love.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
E-Earth, honestly...!

After school.
While tidying up the track and thinking back on the amazing sight from noon――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! My gaze was stolen away by you time and again today.
Standing upon the turf, you were nothing less
than the second coming of the Muse itself...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
There you go again with your honeyed words...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm only speaking from the heart. Your form today was even more gorgeous than usual—truly grazioso...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...It's true that I was paying close attention to my form while running today, but... you were watching really closely, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I was simply drawn in by your dazzling brillante. Just like a butterfly lured by a beautiful blossom, you see.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
...You really are a sinful person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And—you! Thank you for helping clean up today.
In that thoughtful consideration of yours,
I sense pure, unadulterated amore...!
choice_data_list: T-Thanks... You sure are full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And—you! Thank you for helping clean up today.
In that thoughtful consideration of yours,
I sense pure, unadulterated amore...!
choice_data_list: T-Thanks... You sure are full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you think so?
I'm simply putting into words each person's unique musica—their overflowing charm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And to you, indeed.
...Allow me to shower you with all the amore I possess.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You are always giving your all
for the sake of us Umamusume, are you not?
I saw you earlier at noon as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The kindness and beauty within that heart.
How could I not sing its praises?
Now... accept my amore.
